name: maestria
description: Maestria agent pack for Kimi Code - specialist skills with swarm-aware orchestration
skillInstructions:
Maestria dispatch rules for Kimi Code:
- 7 specialist personas: builder, adventurer, architect, planner, reviewer, writer, diagnose
- Use Skill(skill="<persona>") to load a persona, then inline its methodology into Agent()/AgentSwarm() prompts
- builder/diagnose/writer → subagent_type "coder"; adventurer → "explore"; architect/planner/reviewer → "plan"
- Routing table in the orchestrator skill shows the full specialist→subagent mapping
- The orchestrator auto-loads at session start and provides full delegation methodology

interface.shortDescription: Specialized engineering workflow skills for Kimi Code
interface.longDescription: Maestria packages universal rules, 7 specialist personas (builder, adventurer, planner, reviewer, architect, writer, diagnose), and an orchestrator skill that auto-loads at session start. The orchestrator composes personas into prompt templates for Kimi Code's 3 built-in subagents (coder, explore, plan) and uses AgentSwarm for parallel fan-out. Built on the Harness Engineering principle: precise rules, explicit boundaries, and clear delegation chains over raw capability.
